 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Injuries are often a big part of every game in the NFL, including throughout the practice week. For the Cleveland Browns, QB Deshaun Watson's concussion led to a big change , with Shedeur Sanders starting against the New Orleans Saints, and the Browns starter inactive .
 With Cleveland and New Orleans tied at 6-6 late in the third quarter, rookie WR KC Concepion was down on the field after a play that ended up with Sanders being sacked. Replay showed Concepcion trying to get open until the play ended, then he started to limp before going down.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Trainers had to help Concepcion off the field with him putting very little weight on his right leg. With the injury being of the non-contact variety, concerns about something major immediately popped up. Given how the play went, a hamstring injury is also possible.
 Concepcion came out of the blue tent with his helmet but was noticeably limping. After the Saints were forced to punt, Concepcion was back to return it.
